cases.name: task_waiting_for_review_only_in_needs_you
cases.description: A task its supervisor judged finished (pending_review) waits for the user's review: it is in Needs you and not in In progress.

cases.name: task_waiting_for_decision_only_in_needs_you
cases.description: A task with an open ask (decide) and a needs_user one are both in Needs you, once each, even while the first one's agent still works.

cases.name: running_task_once_without_its_agent
cases.description: A task whose agent works is one In progress row; its agent is not a row of its own, though the main conversation lists Agents opened by hand.

cases.name: task_agent_question_only_in_needs_you
cases.description: A task whose agent asks something is one Needs you row (the task, carrying the question); it leaves In progress, and its agent is no row of its own.

cases.name: answered_task_back_in_progress
cases.description: Once the question is answered (no card left, the agent works again) the same task is back in In progress.

cases.name: manual_agent_question_only_in_needs_you
cases.description: In the main conversation an Agent opened by hand (no task) that asks something is a Needs you row, not an In progress one.

cases.name: manual_agent_working_only_in_progress
cases.description: In the main conversation a working Agent opened by hand is an In progress row; idle, unread and the assistant's own sessions are in neither.

cases.name: manual_agents_only_in_the_main_conversation
cases.description: Another conversation lists only its own tasks: no Agents opened by hand, and no task of another conversation.

questions.question: Which port should the demo use?

cases.name: main_conversation_watches_every_task
cases.description: The main conversation has a row for every task, whatever conversation dispatched it.

cases.name: finished_tasks_in_neither
cases.description: Done, cancelled and accepted tasks are in neither entry; the board has them.

cases.name: plan_and_message_wait_for_the_user
cases.description: A plan waiting for Start is one Needs you row (whatever its task count), and so is a message card waiting for Send; a sent card and a started plan are in neither.

cases.name: interrupted_and_failed_tasks_need_you
cases.description: A task whose turn broke off on a model error, and one whose agent never started (the hub ends it with done_at), wait for the user to continue or retry: Needs you.

cases.name: superseded_failed_start_in_neither
cases.description: A task whose agent never started, in the same plan as a task that really finished (a review closed it): the work got done, so the failed start waits on nobody and is finished, in neither entry, as the To-dos page has it (#3713). Another failed start with nothing finished beside it still needs the user.

cases.name: stale_task_folded_not_counted
cases.description: An open task with nothing running and no activity for 48 hours is folded under In progress (shelved) and not counted; a stopped task from today is an In progress row.

cases.name: manual_task_question_has_one_task_row
cases.description: A hand-made task carries its current agent question once, without a second Agent row.

cases.name: manual_running_task_folds_current_agent
cases.description: A hand-made task whose agent works has one In progress row, regardless of its missing origin.

cases.name: done_manual_task_releases_running_agent
cases.description: A done hand-made task is no longer a row; its still-working agent is an independent In progress row.

cases.name: released_manual_link_does_not_hide_agent
cases.description: A released historical link does not fold an independently asking Agent into the remaining hand-made task row.
